name: Frostmane tribe
summary: The Frostmane tribe consists of fierce ice trolls indigenous to the frigid peaks of Dun Morogh. Driven into caves and remote ridges by the dwarves of Ironforge centuries ago, they wage an unrelenting guerrilla war to reclaim their ancestral home.

sections.title: Exiles of the High Crags
sections.body: Long before the Bronzebeard clan united under Ironforge, the Frostmane trolls held dominion across the snowbound expanses of Dun Morogh. The rise and expansion of the dwarven kingdom crushed their realm, pushing the surviving ice trolls into retreat along the frozen ridges and crags. This humiliating defeat sparked a bitter generational hatred that endures to this day. The Frostmane treat every mountaineer, traveler, and homestead as an invading enemy to be driven out or slaughtered.

sections.title: A Seized Opportunity
sections.body: For decades, the Ironforge Senate regarded the Frostmane as little more than a persistent nuisance lurking in the hills. However, the sudden emergence of the trogg menace deep beneath Dun Morogh has thrown dwarven defense into disarray. Sensing an opportune moment while the mountaineers are overwhelmed and dwarven forces fight Alliance wars abroad, the Frostmane have launched renewed and violent raids from strongholds such as Frostmane Hold and Shimmer Ridge to retake their ancient territories.

sections.title: Raiders of the Valleys
sections.body: The Senate of Ironforge eventually took note of the growing threat and sent Grelin Whitebeard and his brother Senir to deal with it. From the caves of Frostmane Hold and the heights of Shimmer Ridge, the trolls strike at the dwarves, and in Coldridge Valley war leaders like Grik'nir the Cold direct aggressive incursions against the mountaineers.

faq.answer: They are a tribe of ice trolls native to the snowy crags of Dun Morogh. Centuries ago, they ruled the region before dwarven armies defeated them and forced them into the high ridges.

faq.q: Why are the Frostmane attacking the dwarves now?
faq.answer: With dwarven mountaineers strained by trogg invasions and military commitments across the Alliance, the Frostmane see an opening to reclaim their ancestral hunting grounds and take revenge on Ironforge.
The tribe raids from Frostmane Hold and Shimmer Ridge, and its war bands are led by aggressive figures like Grik'nir the Cold, who harries the dwarves of Coldridge Valley.

Frostmane Hold remains the tribe's stronghold, a troll-held cave in the hills of Dun Morogh from which the Frostmane launch their raids. The Senate of Ironforge sent Grelin Whitebeard and his brother Senir to deal with the threat.

faq.q: What is Shimmerweed, and why do the trolls gather it?
faq.answer: Shimmerweed is a resilient plant growing in the bitter winds of Shimmer Ridge. The Frostmane cultivate and harvest it for their sacred tribal rituals, though dwarven brewers prize it as an ingredient for potent stout.

faq.q: Are the Frostmane aligned with the Horde?
faq.answer: No. The Frostmane are independent ice trolls who bear virulent hatred toward all outsiders, attacking travelers and explorers regardless of faction.

angles.text: For dwarves, the Frostmane are a constant reminder of ancestral blood feuds. Queen Eimear herself fell to an ambush by Frostmane trolls, making the mountaineers' defense of Dun Morogh deeply personal.
While Darkspear trolls share the broad heritage of trollkind, the isolated Frostmane are savage ice trolls with little interest in kinship, treating Horde visitors as intruders on their sacred peaks.
The crag boars and beasts kept around Frostmane encampments provide rough game meat for hearthside rations amidst Dun Morogh's biting snows.
